thread:
maya (marketing): quick sync — we're aiming to publish the release post + benchmark writeup the same day as the staged rollout. need engineering confirmation on changelog URL, docs links, and a rollout time window we can announce in comms. is Thu 09:00 PT still the target?

josh (eng): Thu 09:00 PT works for the canary. final freeze by Wed 18:00 PT. i can point to the changelog once it's pushed to the release branch.

sasha (docs): putting final edits in now. i will push the docs PR and add the canonical link to the release page: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.2.0 — will post once merged.

maya (marketing): perfect — please paste the merged changelog URL in this thread so we can update the post and the webinar slide deck. also want to confirm benchmark numbers and whether we can publish the raw test harness.

josh (eng): benchmark numbers are cleared for public. ana, liam: are you ok with the throughput/latency charts? i can share the harness repo link (internal) but need to redact some infra specifics before public release.

ana (growth): (typo) sorry, meant ana. :sweat_smile: ana (growth): the charts look good. prefer we publish anonymized harness and a short note about test config instead of full infra details.

liam (product): agree with ana. for the release post let's include a one-paragraph explainer of the workload and a link to a short reproducibility guide. sasha, can we fit that into the docs?

sasha (docs): yep — adding a /repro guide under the release page and a small YAML snippet for the test config. will link both from the changelog. sample snippet i'm adding:```yaml
workload: embedding-heavy
seq_len: 1024
batching: dynamic
quant: q4_0
```

maya (marketing): awesome. final checklist for publish: changelog URL, docs release page, benchmark charts, webinar RSVP link, and a short ops note about canary fallback. josh can you confirm the fallback window?

josh (eng): fallback policy in place — canary for 2 hours, autorevert if error rate > 2% or p99 latency > 2x baseline. ops will monitor and we have a hotfix path.

deploy-bot: scheduled staged rollout for release/v1.2.0 -> canary cluster at 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z (2h canary). CID: rwd-deploy-231.

maya (marketing): thanks — i'm drafting the post now. i'll wait for sasha's final pushed links and josh's confirmation of the changelog URL before we hit publish. aim to send to editorial review by Wed 20:00 PT.

sasha (docs): merged docs PR and changelog posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.2.0/changelog. added reproducibility guide and YAML snippet.

josh (eng): changelog URL looks good. :thumbsup: i'll leave a short note in the changelog about the staged rollout window and rollback criteria.

maya (marketing): perfect — sending draft for review now. tagging editorial and growth for quick pass. thanks everyone :rocket:
